# Programme Risk Register

The programme's risks, categorized and owned, with the dates they are reviewed and the escalations they forced.

## Register

Every open and closed risk, with its impact, probability, status and mitigation.

## Categories

The categories the risks are grouped by, and the category each risk belongs to.

## Owners and review dates

Who owns each risk and the date it is next reviewed; a risk with no owner or review date is refused.

## Escalations

The risks escalated to the programme board, the sponsoring group or the SRO, with the decision each escalation seeks.

## Links

The artefacts and issues the register informs.

items.body: The one-organisation-loop proof (issue #88, T12) has no test and T5/T6 are proposed. The programme's viability verdict must not claim V2 acceptance; tranche 12 cannot record a continue on unbuilt work.
items.title: V2 acceptance (#88/T12) remains open

items.body: All six benefit profiles are draft with placeholder baselines and no measurement instrument. U6 owns the instruments and the before/after transition; no benefit may be claimed realized before that measurement.
items.title: The six benefit baselines are placeholders

items.body: T5, T6, T12, T15 and T17 are proposed, not built. Their tranches must end in pause or stop rather than a fabricated continue, and no project is chartered or closed on unbuilt work.
